entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de caducidad al menos 3 meses posterior al día en que planea salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: You can travel without a visa to the Schengen area and San Marino for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
entry.es: Se puede viajar sin visado al espacio Schengen y a San Marino hasta 90 días en cualquier periodo de 180 días.
entry.quote: You can travel without a visa to the Schengen area and San Marino for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.

entry.en: You must travel through Italy to enter San Marino.
entry.es: Hay que pasar por Italia para entrar en San Marino.
entry.quote: You will need to travel through Italy to enter San Marino.

entry.en: You do not need to pass border controls, but you must have a passport with a valid entry stamp from a Schengen country.
entry.es: No hay que pasar controles fronterizos, pero se necesita un pasaporte con un sello de entrada válido de un país Schengen.
entry.quote: You do not need to pass through border controls to enter San Marino, but you must have a passport containing a valid entry stamp from a Schengen area country.

entry.en: You must register with the Gendarmerie and get a permit of stay if visiting for more than 30 days or planning to work.
entry.es: Debe registrarse en la Gendarmería y obtener un permiso de estancia si visita más de 30 días o planea trabajar.
entry.quote: You must go to the Gendarmerie to register and get a permit of stay if you are visiting for more than 30 days or are planning to work.

entry.en: Customs rules for goods brought into and out of San Marino are the same as for Italy.
entry.es: Las normas aduaneras para los bienes que entran y salen de San Marino son las mismas que las de Italia.
entry.quote: The rules about goods that can be brought into and taken out of San Marino are the same as for Italy.

safety.en: Street crime is very rare, but you should take precautions to keep your passport and money safe.
safety.es: El delito callejero es muy raro, pero conviene tomar precauciones para proteger el pasaporte y el dinero.
safety.quote: Street crime is very rare, but you should take precautions to keep your passport and money safe.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in San Marino cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en San Marino.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in San Marino cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: There is a zero-tolerance policy towards possession and use of illegal drugs, with prison or a heavy fine on conviction.
safety.es: Hay tolerancia cero hacia la posesión y el consumo de drogas ilegales, con prisión o multa elevada si hay condena.
safety.quote: There is a zero-tolerance policy towards the possession and use of illegal drugs. If you are convicted, you will face a prison sentence or a heavy fine.

safety.en: Drivers need both the 1968 international driving permit and their UK licence in the car.
safety.es: Los conductores necesitan en el coche el permiso de conducir internacional de 1968 y su licencia británica.
safety.quote: You’ll need to have both the 1968 version of the international driving permit (IDP) and your UK driving licence with you in the car.

safety.en: San Marino is described as an extremely safe country where you are unlikely to face major dangers.
safety.es: San Marino se describe como un país extremadamente seguro donde es poco probable enfrentar grandes peligros.
safety.quote: San Marino is an extremely safe country. You are unlikely to face any major dangers or threats.

safety.en: Drivers are required to carry a red warning triangle.
safety.es: Los conductores deben llevar un triángulo de advertencia rojo.
safety.quote: If you plan on driving around in the country, you are required to carry a red warning triangle with you.

health.en: The EHIC and GHIC are not accepted in San Marino, so comprehensive travel and medical insurance is advised.
health.es: La EHIC y la GHIC no se aceptan en San Marino, por lo que se aconseja un seguro médico y de viaje completo.
health.quote: The European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) and Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) are not accepted in San Marino. Take out comprehensive travel and medical insurance before travelling.

health.en: For urgent medical attention you can visit the San Marino state hospital.
health.es: Para atención médica urgente se puede acudir al hospital estatal de San Marino.
health.quote: If you need urgent medical attention, you can visit the San Marino state hospital.

health.es: El agua del grifo es potable.

health.en: Procedures are the same as the European Union, although serious conditions will likely see you transferred to Rimini.
health.es: Los procedimientos son los de la Unión Europea, aunque los casos graves probablemente se trasladan a Rímini.
health.quote: If you become ill, procedures are the same as the European Union, although serious conditions will likely see you transferred to Rimini.

help.en: Emergency numbers are ambulance 118, fire 115, and police 112 or 113.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 118, bomberos 115 y policía 112 o 113.

help.en: FCDO can be called in London on 020 7008 5000, 24 hours, for urgent help about a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres al 020 7008 5000, las 24 horas, para ayuda urgente por un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

help.en: Many countries have no embassy in San Marino and are represented from Rome.
help.es: Muchos países no tienen embajada en San Marino y están representados desde Roma.
help.quote: Other countries may not have embassies or consulates in San Marino, but in Rome to represent both Italy and San Marino.

getting_in.en: San Marino is only accessible through Italy and has no border controls with Italy.
getting_in.es: Solo se accede a San Marino a través de Italia y no hay controles fronterizos con Italia.
getting_in.quote: San Marino is only accessible through Italy. There are no border controls when travelling between Italy and San Marino

getting_in.en: San Marino has no airports; the nearest major airport is Federico Fellini International Airport (RMI) at Rimini.
getting_in.es: San Marino no tiene aeropuertos; el más cercano es el Aeropuerto Internacional Federico Fellini (RMI) en Rímini.
getting_in.quote: San Marino has no airports. The nearest major airport is the 1 Federico Fellini International Airport (RMI IATA) at Rimini.

getting_in.en: San Marino has no railway stations and the nearest major station is at Rimini.
getting_in.es: San Marino no tiene estaciones de tren y la más cercana importante está en Rímini.
getting_in.quote: San Marino has no railway stations. The nearest major railway station is at Rimini.

getting_in.en: A bus runs from Rimini to San Marino daily about once an hour, with a single ticket at €7 (May 2026).
getting_in.es: Un autobús va de Rímini a San Marino a diario aproximadamente cada hora, con billete sencillo de 7 € (mayo 2026).
getting_in.quote: A bus runs from Rimini to San Marino daily about once an hour, with stops along the way in Dogana, Serravalle, Domagnano, and Borgo Maggiore. A single ticket costs €7 (May 2026).

getting_in.en: The City of San Marino has limited parking, so the text suggests parking in Borgo Maggiore and taking the cable car up.
getting_in.es: La ciudad de San Marino tiene aparcamiento limitado, por lo que se sugiere aparcar en Borgo Maggiore y subir en teleférico.
getting_in.quote: The City of San Marino has limited parking, so why not leave your car in nearby Borgo Maggiore and take the cable car up to the city?

getting_around.en: The walled city is small enough to walk around, though it is quite vertical, with elevators scattered throughout town.
getting_around.es: La ciudad amurallada es lo bastante pequeña para recorrerla a pie, aunque es muy empinada, con ascensores repartidos por la ciudad.
getting_around.quote: Once you're inside the walled city, it's small enough to simply walk around.

getting_around.en: A 1.5 km cable railway connects the city of San Marino to Borgo Maggiore, at €3 one-way or €5 round-trip (Aug 2024).
getting_around.es: Un teleférico de 1,5 km une la ciudad de San Marino con Borgo Maggiore, a 3 € el trayecto sencillo o 5 € ida y vuelta (ago 2024).
getting_around.quote: There is a 1.5 km (0.93 mi) cable railway (funivia) connecting the city of San Marino to Borgo Maggiore. €3 for a one-way ticket, €5 round-trip (Aug 2024).

getting_around.en: Outside the capital walking is not easy, as sidewalks are inconsistent, especially between towns.
getting_around.es: Fuera de la capital caminar no es fácil, ya que las aceras son irregulares, sobre todo entre localidades.
getting_around.quote: sidewalks are inconsistent at best, especially when going between towns.

getting_around.en: The roadways are curvy, steep and narrow, so carrying a map is suggested.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras son sinuosas, empinadas y estrechas, por lo que se sugiere llevar un mapa.
getting_around.quote: The roadways in San Marino are curvy, steep, and narrow. To avoid getting disoriented, it is a good idea to carry a map.

getting_around.en: The posted speed limit is 70 km/h.
getting_around.es: El límite de velocidad señalizado es de 70 km/h.
getting_around.quote: San Marino's posted speed limit is 70 km/h.

money.quote: San Marino uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: Some items are cheaper than in Italy partly because the 20% IVA (VAT) charged in Italy is not paid in San Marino.
money.es: Algunos artículos son más baratos que en Italia en parte porque en San Marino no se paga el IVA del 20 % que se paga en Italia.
money.quote: This is partly because in San Marino you don't have to pay the 20% IVA (VAT) that you have to pay in Italy.

etiquette.en: Visitors should not act as if San Marino is part of Italy or confuse the Sammarinese with Italians, as this is likely to cause offence.
etiquette.es: No se debe actuar como si San Marino fuera parte de Italia ni confundir a los sanmarinenses con italianos, pues es probable que ofenda.
etiquette.quote: do not act as if San Marino is a part of Italy and do not confuse the Sammarinese with Italians. This is likely to cause offence.

etiquette.en: Be respectful when taking photos with the guards; a smile is fine but gestures or funny faces are not well received.
etiquette.es: Hay que ser respetuoso al sacarse fotos con los guardias; una sonrisa basta, pero los gestos o muecas no se ven bien.
etiquette.quote: Be respectful when taking photos with the guards. A smile will do, but hand gestures/funny faces will not be received well.

etiquette.en: The Sammarinese take their national politics seriously, and asking about the political situation is unlikely to cause offence.
etiquette.es: Los sanmarinenses se toman muy en serio la política nacional y es poco probable ofender al preguntar por la situación política.
etiquette.quote: The Sammarinese tend to take politics of their nation very seriously. You're unlikely to cause offence by asking about the country's political situation.

connectivity.en: Free Wi-Fi is available in parts of the city.
connectivity.es: Hay wifi gratuito en algunas partes de la ciudad.
connectivity.quote: Free Wi-Fi is available in parts of the city.
